written: BEFORE any round-2 model score existed; see the commit that introduces this file
question: Is the Punkdisco drums loss an OUTLIER or a CLASS?

background.round_1: n=5 tracks gated on BASS. htdemucs_ft beat the default on drums on 4 of 5, but lost Punkdisco - Oral Hygiene by 4.725 dB, dragging the mean to -0.374 while the median was +0.589.
background.why_it_matters: If the loss is an outlier, the mean is the wrong statistic and the default switch stands. If it is a class, a predictable slice of the catalogue would regress on drums and the switch is unsafe.

hypothesis_H1_class.statement: The htdemucs family loses drums on tracks where the DRUMS STEM DOMINATES its window, and hdemucs_mmi is more robust on exactly that material.
operational_predictors: high drums energy_share (share of summed stem energy)
high drums mixture_floor_si_sdr (the do-nothing floor: a floor near or above 0 dB means the mixture already largely IS the drums)
hypothesis_H1_class.prediction_if_TRUE: htdemucs_ft loses drums to hdemucs_mmi on most of Detsky Sad, BKS - Bulldozer and AM Contra, and the per-track drums delta correlates negatively with drums energy_share and with the drums mixture floor.
hypothesis_H1_class.prediction_if_FALSE: Punkdisco stands alone: the other drum-dominant tracks behave like the rest of the sample, no correlation appears, and the median is the statistic to read.

hypothesis_H0_outlier.statement: Punkdisco is a single anomalous track with no shared character, so the drums mean in round 1 was distorted by one point out of five.

decision_rule_fixed_in_advance.class: If htdemucs_ft loses drums by more than the 0.2 dB audibility bar on a MAJORITY of the drum-dominant tracks, treat it as a class: do NOT recommend switching the default outright, and recommend per-stem routing or a content-conditional choice instead.
decision_rule_fixed_in_advance.outlier: If Punkdisco remains the only large loss and no correlation with the predictors appears, treat it as an outlier: the median is the statistic, and the default switch stands.
decision_rule_fixed_in_advance.unresolved: If the losses are neither concentrated in the predicted class nor confined to Punkdisco, report the drums question as still unsettled and do not let it block or force the switch.

sample.round_2_selection_rule: alphabetical order of the MUSDB18-HQ test split, skipping tracks with a committed gate row, first 6 taken; fixed before any score existed

protocol: unchanged from round 1: 60 s gate-chosen windows cut on bifrost2 during transfer, verified against the gate's own statistics, overlap 0.25, shifts 0, 44.1 kHz, Modal H100 via scripts/modal_vocal_farm.py::separate_track, SI-SDR against TRUE MUSDB18-HQ stems, mixture floor as the do-nothing arm.
